intro: Create your favorite spot to unwind with Nurest. The finish brings warmth to your interiors while the recline, rock, and swivel keep you cocooned in effortless comfort every single day.

features.title: Triple movement for true ease
features.text: Enjoy the soothing rhythm of rocking, a smooth recline up to 150°, and 360° swivel — all designed to move the way you want to rest.

features.title: Cloud comfort cushioning
features.text: Plush cushioning across head, back, arms, and seat creates a sink-in feeling that supports you whether reading, chatting, or napping.

features.title: Flexible seating design
features.text: Lower armrests let you sit cross-legged or stretch out without restrictions, giving you more room to relax in your own style.

features.title: Handy side pockets
features.text: Keep remotes, books, or gadgets close at hand with dual zipped side pockets, so you never interrupt your comfort to reach for essentials.

features.title: Breathable soft fabric
features.text: Camel-coloured fabric upholstery brings a warm, earthy tone that adds both coziness and timeless elegance to your living space.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Nurest Manual 1-Seater Fabric Rocking And Revolving Recliner
